meanings.note: with a past-tense verb: я бы подумал = I would think
wishes: купили бы = we could have bought

examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.
The governor has come to the town.
According to new data, the situation has changed.

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.
There's someone here to see you.

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.
There are a lot of people here.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
plural, also the TV news programme

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.trans: He turned away from the window.

examples.text: Друзья не отвернулись от него в беде.
examples.trans: Friends did not turn away from him in trouble.

examples.text: А я испорчу отношения с будущим мэром.
examples.trans: And I'll ruin my relationship with the future mayor.
We have a very warm relationship.
I love our town very much.

meanings.en: to rise, to go up, to ascend

examples.trans: He went up to the second floor.

examples.text: Он подорвал свое здоровье тяжелой работой.
examples.trans: He undermined his health with hard work.

examples.text: На столе стоял полный стакан воды.
examples.trans: A full glass of water stood on the table.

meanings.en: to sell oneself, betray principles for gain

examples.text: Люди подумали, что он продался властям.
examples.trans: People thought he sold out to authorities.

examples.text: Он никогда не продавался за деньги.
examples.trans: He never sold out for money.

examples.text: Они накрутили со своими бандитскими процентами.
examples.trans: They piled it on with their gangster interest rates.
A loan at a low interest rate.

meanings.en: to grow, to grow up, to develop

examples.text: Вообще надо расти во всех смыслах.
examples.trans: In general, I need to grow in every sense.

meanings.note: поднять рейтинг = to boost someone's poll numbers

examples.trans: The candidate has a high approval rating.
This is a very complicated situation.

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.
